text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Bono-chan and Biko-chan
in the Sprinters Stakes were so intense!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"‘Big Bono-chan and little Biko-chan
both giving it their all and clashing with everything
they had was truly inspiring!’"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Racing really is great. I'm looking forward to today's race too. Give it everything you've got!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, these comments make me so happy.
Everyone is cheering for me~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I took a quick peek earlier,
and so many people have come out to cheer for you~"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The stands were packed full,
and it made me so happy. Ehehe.
"The duel between Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus at the Sprinters Stakes made major waves, so their rematch drew tremendous attention."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yup, I'll do my absolute best~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh, that's right!
Trainer-san, check this out!”

With that, Hishi Akebono
pulled out—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I made us a bento~♪

"Nori rolls, inari sushi, tamagoyaki, sausages,
salad, fried shrimp, karaage, simmered dishes...
It was such a vibrant, colorful bento box!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, my mom and dad would pack this
huge multi-tiered bento box for Sports Day, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I remembered how super happy I was,
and how it made me wanna try even harder~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So I thought we could all eat this before the race
to get totally pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'll go call Biko-chan real quick~.

I hurriedly stop Hishi Akebono
as she tries to dash out the door.
choice_data_list: Shall we eat it for dinner?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why is that~?
choice_data_list: You shouldn't eat too much before a race, so...

text_block_list.text:
I swallowed the words,
"In the first place, we only just ate lunch a moment ago..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right~!
Ahaha, that's how it was!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well then, that's something to look forward to tonight~!

The side dishes packed in without any gaps
must be Hishi Akebono's way of showing her dedication.
While praying for her victory, I wrapped the tiered food boxes back up.
